newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares edge up at noon in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares edge up at noon in slow trade.

text.p: Shanghai B shares edged up at midday on Thursday with market sentiment improving as investors regained confidence after the recent crackdown moves by Beijing, brokers said.
The B index edged up 0.532 points or 0.64 percent to 83.612 points on thin turnover of 4.937 million shares worth $2.778 million.
"Most of the negative news about anti-speculation has been digested," said one local broker.
The A share market ended at 1,290.308 points, up 3.145 points or 0.24 percent on volume of 1.639 billion yuan.
"If the afternoon is stable, the A and B shares could both gain a little bit," the broker said.

The markets were rattled last week when Beijing sacked the president of a Shenzhen-listed bank and officials of three major brokerages for illegal trading in the latest move to clamp down on the overheating markets.
Some brokers said the morning's slim turnover was evidence that market sentiment had not fully recovered from the crackdown.
"On this kind of turnover you won't see much of a rise in the afternoon," another broker said.
"The rebound will be short-lived amid unstable market sentiment," the broker said.
Of 44 B shares, 34 traded with 16 up, 10 flat and eight down.
Shanghai Diesel Engine Co was the biggest gainer on news that it had set up a joint venture, surging $0.032 or 9.75 percent to $0.360 on volume of 303,000 shares.
Shanghai Waigaoqiao Free Trade Zone Development Co Ltd also performed well after the duty-free zone said it was expanding to accomodate more foreign companies.
The stock rose $0.020 or 3.59 percent to $0.576 on volume of 486,000 shares.
Newcomer Jinan Qingqi Motorcycle continued to be the most actively traded, gaining $0.004 or 0.75 percent to $0.532 on volume of 1.2 million shares.
The SSE30 blue chip index rose 41.067 points or 1.08 percent to 3,859.300 points.
On the A share index, Jiangxi Paper Co was the biggest winner on institutional speculative buying, climbing 0.89 yuan or 5.46 percent to 17.19 yuan on volume of 530,300 shares.
